outcome: PRRSV viremia levels (serum, bronchoalveolar lavage fluid)
cohort: A total of 50 feeder pigs were challenged with Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome Virus (PRRSV) 1-4-4 L1C.
finding: Ivermectin administered to pigs post virulent PRRS 1-4-4 L1C challenge did not reduce the level of viremia in serum or BAL fluid but showed a trend toward reducing lung lesions.
